scripts.test: npm run verify:map-source && npm run test --workspaces --if-present && node --test "test/*.test.js" "scripts/maps-assessment/*.test.mjs" && npm run test:local-map-catalog
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm run typecheck:local-map-catalog
scripts.build: npm run verify:map-source && npm run build --workspaces --if-present && npm run build:local-map-catalog
scripts.build:local-map-catalog: npm run build -w packages/maps && tsc -p tools/local-map-catalog/tsconfig.json
scripts.typecheck:local-map-catalog: npm run build -w packages/maps && tsc --noEmit -p tools/local-map-catalog/tsconfig.json
